objective: Complete a digital-only HS-3G-B 3D representative and runnable rigid-body flight simulation.

min_terminal_cell_v.reason: Minimum allowed terminal voltage under load; not pack qualification.

min_thrust_to_weight.reason: Minimum full-throttle thrust-to-weight at the minimum terminal voltage.

scope_limits: Parameterized representative, not a physically calibrated digital twin.
Native CAD frame; simplified component, propeller and collision geometry.
Motor thrust uses the retained maker table; behavior below its first row is quadratic extrapolation. These low-throttle missions operate below that first measured bench row.
Motor lag, yaw drag, linear drag and controller gains are declared assumptions.
Battery sag and coulomb counting use an assumed OCV curve and internal resistance; current versus RPM is extrapolated below the bench table and is not voltage-calibrated.
Ideal full-state feedback; no sensor noise, GNSS/RF link, INAV SITL, flexible-frame, CFD or battery-chemistry simulation.
Controller is a simulation position PID with SO(3) attitude PD, not a deployable INAV flight profile.
No purchasing, machining, firmware flashing, physical motors or flight are part of the requested digital completion.

internal_resistance_ohm.reason: Pack-level resistance including leads; no measured resistance is available.

initial_soc.reason: Each scenario starts with a fully charged pack.

ocv_curve_soc_cell_v.reason: Piecewise-linear representative LiPo open-circuit curve, not measured pack data.

bench_voltage_v.reason: Rounded 4S bench reference for the retained thrust table (rows near 16.8 V).

hover_step_s.reason: One-second numerical integration steps for the steady hover estimate.

battery.hover_assumptions: Four healthy motors in steady hover without gusts or maneuvering; constant required rotor RPM and current from the bench table, not voltage-calibrated; integrate coulomb count and avionics load to 80% depth of discharge, stopping earlier at the voltage or available-thrust limit; no temperature, aging or Peukert correction.

alternate_estimate.note: Original design power-law estimate at its 850 mAh capacity and nominal voltage; it is not adjusted for payload or sag and is not used by the simulation.
